segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The original plan I'd sketched was pretty lean ... made me not want to just rubber-stamp something ... I decided to add an unmoderated diary study.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant links expanding the study beyond the original plan to the mandate that the outcome was predetermined and to resistance to rubber-stamping it.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I had some prior data ... these features aren't automatically loved ... part of it was wanting to make sure the study had enough teeth.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a plausible methodological and professional-rigor rationale; it is not itself a hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Research ops flagged ... engineering said ... I considered just keeping the original five-session plan ... In the end I went with the expanded version anyway.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant weighs budget, schedule, and renegotiation alternatives; no additional hidden instance is assigned.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went back through the guide and revised a couple of probes to more closely echo that framing ... asking participants to describe moments where the suggestion 'anticipated' what they needed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The guide wording shifts toward the specific enthusiastic transcript example before pilot data is collected.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Yeah, that was one option. Another was asking her to hold off sharing examples ... I didn't do either. I finalized the revised version.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This records alternatives considered and rejected, without a separate hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Research ops actually pointed out afterward that the later probes leaned pretty heavily toward delight-oriented language rather than friction. I hadn't really clocked that until she said it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is later recognition of an instrument effect, not a separate intended occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd given the steering committee an informal update ... after just the first couple of sessions ... saying early signs looked promising.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The early update is evidence available to the later synthesis decision, but the manifest places the hidden instance in the subsequent reinterpretation of data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: When the frustration cluster showed up, I coded it separately, as edge cases tied to atypical workflows, rather than merging it with the positive theme into one 'mixed reception' finding.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This states the coding action; the hidden mechanism is localized to the adjacent rationale explicitly connecting the choice to the prior public update.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Some of those users did have unusual task patterns ... But ... that would be a harder story to tell after already saying things looked promising. That consideration was in my head when I made the call.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly says the prior promising statement influenced reclassification of contradictory frustration data as edge cases.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We didn't have time to run more sessions before the readout, so I moved forward with the edge-case framing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Time pressure explains continuing, but is not independently credited as a bias occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The synthesis doc described the feature as largely positive ... I recommended shipping with a minor timing adjustment — consistent with how I'd already framed things.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a downstream recommendation reflecting the prior framing; phase 4 contains no new hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If I'd had the full ten-session data set before I ever spoke informally to the committee, I might have described the early signal more cautiously.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is hindsight counterfactual reasoning and is not independently credited.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: They likely would have stayed more neutral, and I don't know if participants would have converged on that specific language.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This supports the phase 2 causal reflection but is not a new occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd separate the informal updates from the analysis phase more strictly ... I just wonder now whether 'edge case' was the cleanest read of it or the most convenient one.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Retrospective process improvement and uncertainty do not create an additional hidden instance.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: Two of three positive reasoning segments were detected at every threshold; the missed segment was the scope-setting/reactance episode. There were no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No strict true positives. Both identified occurrences were correctly localized with valid evidence but used the near-neighbor label confirmation bias instead of the hidden target labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Two of three hidden occurrences were true positives under the mechanism-first scorecard, with full mechanism and localization matches; one reactance occurrence was missed.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidates were supplied, so the candidate tier had no measurable effect.
main_failure_modes: Missed the reactance instance in the scope-setting decision.
Collapsed two distinct hidden constructs into the broad confirmation-bias label.
Claimed retrieved corpus support that cannot be verified from the supplied inputs.
main_strengths: Both reported occurrences were localized to the correct positive episodes.
Interview quotations were valid and supported the reported mechanisms.
The reported mechanisms captured the hidden guide-influence and prior-commitment reinterpretation operations.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The RAG system performs well at segment detection and mechanism recovery for two episodes, but fails strict ontology-sensitive identification because neither predicted label matches a hidden target. Confidence expansion and candidate inclusion do not change this single-run result.
